text:
serena: FYI vendor just emailed that starting next payroll cycle they'll add a $1.50/month per-employee administrative fee to the 401k recordkeeping line item. Does that change the match calculation or payroll file mapping?

drew-payroll: good catch. The fee is post-payroll in most vendors I’ve seen — usually deducted from plan admin budget, not employee deferrals. But need to confirm with our vendor mapping. @jamie-people can you share the vendor note? :thinking:

jamie-people: pasted excerpt from vendor: "Starting 2024-05-01 a monthly admin fee of $1.50 per participant will be applied to plan billing. This fee will not be deducted from participant deferrals; it will be invoiced to the employer account."

vendor-hr-bot: [Automated] Support ticket #8921 created for: "Clarify admin fee handling and payroll file impact". Estimated vendor response: 48-72 hrs.

drew-payroll: ok that wording suggests employer-billed, so shouldn't change match calc. But request: confirm it is not represented as a separate deduction code in the payroll export. If vendor starts sending a deduction code, our payroll parser could mis-assign it to pre-tax deductions.

marta-legal: from a compliance POV, as long as fee is employer-billed and not reducing employee deferrals or company match, we're fine. If vendor tries to offset match or show net employee contribution, we need a written amendment.

alex: quick question — will this affect eligibility/auto-enroll notices or anything participants see in the console? Even a $1.50 line might confuse folks if visible in their statement.

jamie-people: good call. I asked vendor whether the fee shows on participant statements. They said "no, employer billing only" but will follow up with screenshot.

drew-payroll: action items for payroll: 1) watch next export for any new deduction codes named "RK"); 2) add a validation rule to reject unknown deduction codes and flag for manual review; 3) if vendor creates a code, we'll map it to employer_billing in our internal mapping table. Example rule: 

```
if deduction_code not in expected_codes:
  flag_for_review(thread_ts)
```

serena: thanks. jamie — can you confirm vendor screenshot when they reply and paste here. Also please CC finance so they can expect the invoice.

jamie-people: will do. cc @dana-finance when update arrives.

vendor-hr-bot: [Automated] Support ticket #8921 status: vendor replied — "Fee billed to employer; no participant-facing statement; no payroll deduction code." (attaching vendor reply)

drew-payroll: sweet. once vendor reply is attached I’ll check next payroll run and add the parser rule.

marta-legal: I also asked benefits counsel to confirm this doesn't require plan amendment; they said likely not for a billing change, will confirm in writing by EOD.

alex: appreciated. small but good to triage before it shows up on a statement. :thumbsup:

serena: closing loop — we'll wait for the vendor screenshot + counsel note. If either says otherwise we escalate to plan administrator. Thanks everyone.
